column1: # keep-distinct rows are also what check_no_duplicate_value_key honours (task_942):
#   * derive / delete : the two keys MUST resolve to the SAME value (a divergence is a
#                       silent SSOT bug the de-dup campaign must fix, not hide).
#   * keep-distinct   : the two keys are DISTINCT FACTS -- two SSOT declarations, never to
#                       be collapsed, whose values MAY coincide. Both gates mean exactly this:
#                       - check_value_aliases fails the row when the resolver's provenance
#                         declaration (that is an alias: derive), when equal values cannot
#                         be traced to two declarations, or when the row carries no reason;
#                       - check_no_duplicate_value_key stops counting the ALIAS column as a
#                         duplicate of the group its CANONICAL column is in. This is the one
#                         sanctioned representation of a coincidental equal value.
#                       The reason must say why either key can change without the other
#                       becoming wrong. If they must change together they are ONE fact:
#                       collapse them instead. A row whose values differ still pins an
#                       alias-shaped false-friend against a name-based collapse.
# Seeded from reference/audit-value-dup-report.md (measured). Grows via mios-dup-report (task_1591).
